verdict.rationale: Omnara explicitly markets itself as 'The API for Production-Grade Agents' with a published OpenAPI spec, and docs state you can launch, manage, and interact with agents via dashboard, CLI, REST API, or TypeScript SDK — indicating API-first parity with the UI. Role-based API keys (omnara-gh-1) further support programmatic control equivalent to UI actions like approvals and configuration. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or independent confirmation that every UI feature (e.g., approvals, skills, image/document attachments) has a documented 1:1 API equivalent, and hands-on verification beyond the OpenAPI probe.
